title: Vakuumhebegerät mit elektrisch angetriebener Pumpe und Energieversorgung im Handgriff

features.item: cordless handheld vacuum lifting device with integrated battery power
features.note: (non-English passage at abstract) The reference describes a vacuum lifting device with an electrically driven pump and an energy supply, handled by a handgrip, indicating a cordless handheld device.
features.quote_src: Vakuumhebegerät (10) zum Anheben und/oder Handhaben von Werkstücken, mit einer Saugvorrichtung (50), die mittels einer elektrisch angetriebenen Pumpe (80) zwischen einer Saugplatte (54) und einem anzuhebenden Werkstück ein Vakuum erzeugt, wobei für die Pumpe (80) eine Energieversorgung (40) vorgesehen ist,

features.item: flexible sealing lip on suction cup that bounds sealed region against workpiece
features.note: (non-English passage at claim 11) The reference explicitly mentions a rubber seal (Gummidichtung) on the underside of the suction plate facing the workpiece, which functions as a flexible sealing lip.
features.quote_src: dass die Saugplatte (54) an ihrer dem anzusaugenden Werkstück zugewandten Unterseite (55) eine Gummidichtung (56) aufweist.

features.item: electric vacuum pump mounted within rigid body to draw air from sealed region
features.note: (non-English passage at abstract) The reference describes an electrically driven pump (80) that creates a vacuum between the suction plate and the workpiece. Claim 6 further states the pump is in a housing attachable to the handle, implying it's mounted within the device's rigid body.

features.item: pressure sensor monitoring vacuum level in sealed region
features.note: The reference does not mention any pressure sensor or means for monitoring the vacuum level.

features.note: The reference does not mention any warning threshold or its definition.

features.item: rechargeable battery integrated into rigid body powering vacuum pump
features.note: (non-English passage at abstract) The reference states that the energy supply (40) for the pump (80) can be accommodated in the handle (20), which is essentially tubular. Claim 4 specifies this energy supply can be an accumulator (rechargeable battery) or a battery.
features.quote_src: dass die Energieversorgung (40) für die Pumpe (80) im Handgriff (20) unterbringbar ist, wobei der Handgriff (20) im Wesentlichen rohrförmig ausgebildet ist

features.item: warning indicator positioned on rigid body for visibility during lifting operation
features.note: The reference mentions an optical display for the charge state of the accumulator but not a warning indicator for vacuum level.

features.item: single-hand portable design with all components carried by rigid body without external hose or cord
features.note: (non-English passage at abstract) The description of a vacuum lifting device with an integrated pump, energy supply in the handle, and a handgrip for handling implies a self-contained, single-hand portable design without external hoses or cords.
